content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], first, congratulations on your excellent work—it's really valuable! I wanted to ask if it's possible to update the data logger to support 64-bit systems, especially for use with the 64-bit version of Microsoft Office. When I run it on Excel 2010 64-bit, there is an issue related to the Ptrsafe attribute in Visual Basic. I'm not an expert in VB and despite trying to fix it, I encountered some problems. Thanks in advance, and keep up the great work. This was originally part of a discussion about the [product_name] data logger.
[user_name] - I haven't had success with the 64-bit version either. I plan to consult some colleagues for advice. [user_name]
Hello [user_name], thank you for your prompt response (I was away for a while). For that project, I switched to using a 32-bit system as a workaround. All the best.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered compatibility problems using the [product_name] data logger with 64-bit Microsoft Excel 2010, specifically due to issues with the Ptrsafe attribute in Visual Basic. This prevented proper function on 64-bit systems, leading the user to revert to a 32-bit setup as a temporary solution. The issue is unresolved and reveals a lack of support for 64-bit platforms in the software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates the data logger will work smoothly on modern 64-bit operating systems and applications, especially Excel 2010 64-bit, without needing to manually adjust the code.
